gate_type: CROSS-PROJECT DEPENDENCY RESOLUTION / PIM EXPORT HANDOFF
objective: Resolve the authoritative PIM source-of-truth/repository/artifact location for the Song Hong Water Treatment Plant (SH WTP) and, ONLY IF that source is proven, reference the exact pinned SH WTP semantic export package from the PIM side and record immutable handoff evidence for VF. VF MUST NOT invent canonical IDs, PIM vocabularies, evidence maturity, site truth, or upstream semantic artifacts. Priority 1 is proving the authoritative PIM source; if it cannot be proven, STOP with BLOCKED FOR SA.
explicit_non_objectives: Do not invent canonical IDs or PIM vocabularies
Do not modify VF production runtime/config/tests
Do not implement VF workspace loader or binding validation
Do not implement CORE provenance threading
Do not convert examples/contracts/wtp-demo-01.contract.yaml into authoritative PIM truth unless its PIM authority is independently proven
Do not copy an unverified VF-side stub and label it as PIM export
forbidden_actions: Invent canonical IDs or PIM vocabularies
Modify production code (src/, configs/, simulators/, tests/)
Convert wtp-demo-01 stub into authoritative PIM truth
Copy unverified VF stub as PIM export
stop_conditions: Authoritative PIM source/repository cannot be proven
Multiple competing PIM sources exist with unclear authority
Export requires choosing a new canonical ID scheme
Required vocabulary/ontology must be invented rather than exported
Site truth/evidence maturity cannot be distinguished from source mapping
Producing the export would require unrelated VF implementation

acceptance_criteria.description: Exported semantic content comes from PIM authority, not VF invention
